transcript: Doctor: Tell me what's been going on. Patient: I've had a fever for three days now, around 39 degrees. I feel really weak and confused. My wife says I've been talking nonsense since this morning. Doctor: Any other symptoms? Patient: I have this pain in my right side, lower abdomen. And I've been urinating a lot, it burns. Doctor: Let me check your vitals. Temperature 39.4, heart rate 118, blood pressure 88 over 55, respiratory rate 26, oxygen saturation 91 percent on room air. Abdomen is tender in the right lower quadrant with guarding. CVA tenderness on the right. Urine is cloudy. Labs show white count 18,200, lactate 4.2, creatinine 2.1, up from baseline of 0.9. Blood cultures drawn times two. Urinalysis shows pyuria and bacteriuria. Assessment: Sepsis secondary to complicated urinary tract infection, likely pyelonephritis with early septic shock. Plan: Start piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 grams IV every 8 hours. Normal saline bolus 30 mL per kg. If MAP stays below 65 after fluids, start norepinephrine. Foley catheter for strict I and O. Repeat lactate in 4 hours. Renal consult if creatinine continues to rise. Blood cultures pending.
reference_soap:
DIALOGUE:
Doctor: Tell me what's been going on.
Patient: Fever for three days (~39°C), weakness, confusion. Wife reports altered mentation since morning.
Doctor: Any other symptoms?
Patient: Right lower abdominal pain, dysuria, frequency.

SUBJECTIVE:
3-day history of fever to 39°C with progressive weakness. Altered mental status noted by family. Right-sided abdominal pain with urinary symptoms (dysuria, frequency).

OBJECTIVE:
Vitals: Temp 39.4°C, HR 118, BP 88/55, RR 26, SpO2 91% RA
Abdomen: RLQ tenderness with guarding, right CVA tenderness
UA: Cloudy urine, pyuria, bacteriuria
Labs: WBC 18,200, Lactate 4.2, Creatinine 2.1 (baseline 0.9)
Blood cultures x2 drawn

ASSESSMENT:
Sepsis secondary to complicated UTI / pyelonephritis with early septic shock

PLAN:
1. Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5g IV q8h
2. NS bolus 30 mL/kg
3. Vasopressors (norepinephrine) if MAP <65 post-fluids
4. Foley catheter, strict I&O
5. Repeat lactate in 4 hours
6. Renal consult PRN
7. Blood cultures pending
